function.name: game_apply_architect_designator
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Apply an Architect designator to one cell or a rectangle, with optional dry-run validation

designatorId.description: Stable designator id returned by rimworld/list_architect_designators

width.description: Rectangle width in cells starting at x/z

height.description: Rectangle height in cells starting at x/z

dryRun.description: Validate placement without mutating the map

keepSelected.description: Keep the designator selected after the call completes

function.name: game_close_window
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Close an open RimWorld window by type name or, if omitted, the topmost window

windowType.description: Optional short or full .NET type name of the target window

function.name: game_dismiss_letter
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Dismiss a specific dismissible letter by native letter id, mirroring a normal right-click on the letter stack entry

function.name: game_drag_cell
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Dispatch a literal live map mouse drag from one current-map cell to another without requiring OS focus, publishing mouse position plus held/down/up button state so vanilla and modd

button.description: Mouse button to inject. Supported values are 'left', 'right', and 'middle'. The gesture is not translated into

holdDurationMs.description: How long to hold the drag at the end cell before releasing it. Use this for mods that distinguish tap from hol

modifiers.description: Optional comma-, space-, or plus-separated event modifiers such as 'shift', 'ctrl', 'alt', or 'command'.

function.name: game_execute_context_menu_option
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Execute a context menu option by index or label

optionIndex.description: 1-based option index. Use -1 to resolve by label instead.

label.description: Exact or partial menu label to execute when optionIndex is -1

function.name: game_execute_gizmo
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Execute one grouped gizmo for the current selection by gizmo id returned from rimworld/list_selected_gizmos

gizmoId.description: Selection-scoped gizmo id returned by rimworld/list_selected_gizmos

function.name: game_get_cell_info
function.description: [READ-ONLY] Inspect one map cell, including things, blueprints, frames, designations, zones, and areas

function.name: game_get_cells_info
function.description: [READ-ONLY] Inspect every map cell in a rectangle up to 1024 cells, including things, blueprints, frames, designations, zones, and areas

width.description: Rectangle width in cells; width * height must not exceed 1024

height.description: Rectangle height in cells; width * height must not exceed 1024

function.name: game_get_context_menu_options
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Get the currently opened debug context menu options

function.name: game_jump_camera_to_cell
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Jump the camera to a map cell

function.name: game_list_alerts
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List active RimWorld alerts with structured culprit targets and alert-snapshot-scoped alert ids

limit.description: Maximum number of active alerts to return

function.name: game_list_architect_categories
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List RimWorld Architect categories using stable category ids

includeHidden.description: Include categories that are currently hidden

includeEmpty.description: Include categories even if they currently expose no designators

function.name: game_list_architect_designators
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List Architect designators for one category, flattening dropdown widgets into actionable child designators

categoryId.description: Stable category id from rimworld/list_architect_categories or the raw category defName

includeHidden.description: Include designators that are currently hidden

function.name: game_list_areas
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List current-map areas such as home, roof, snow-clear, and allowed areas

includeAssignableOnly.description: Include only areas that can be assigned as allowed areas

function.name: game_list_colonists
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List player-controlled colonists available for selection and drafting, including stable pawn ids

currentMapOnly.description: True to only include the current map

function.name: game_list_letters
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List current letter-stack entries with native letter ids, semantic letter content, and structured look-target metadata

limit.description: Maximum number of letters to return

function.name: game_list_selected_gizmos
function.description: [GAME ACTION] List the current selection's actionable grouped gizmos using deterministic selection-scoped gizmo ids

function.name: game_list_zones
function.description: [READ-ONLY] List current-map zones such as stockpiles and growing zones

function.name: game_open_letter
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Open a specific letter by native letter id, mirroring a normal left-click on the letter stack entry

function.name: game_pause_game
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Pause or unpause the game

pause.description: True to pause, false to unpause

function.name: game_press_accept
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Send semantic accept input to the active RimWorld window stack without requiring OS focus

targetPawnName.description: Optional target pawn name on the current map.

z.description: Target cell z coordinate when no pawn name or id is given

button.description: Mouse button to inject. Supported values are 'left', 'right', and 'middle'.

holdDurationMs.description: How long to hold the mouse button down before releasing it. Use this for mods that distinguish tap from hold o

modifiers.description: Optional comma-, space-, or plus-separated event modifiers such as 'shift', 'ctrl', 'alt', or 'command'.

function.name: game_select_architect_designator
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Select an Architect designator by stable id without relying on foreground UI interaction

designatorId.description: Stable designator id returned by rimworld/list_architect_designators

function.name: game_select_pawn
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Select a single colonist by name or stable pawn id

pawnName.description: Optional colonist name, short name, or full name

pawnId.description: Optional stable colonist pawn id from rimworld/list_colonists

append.description: True to append to the current selection instead of replacing it

function.name: game_set_draft
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Draft or undraft a colonist by name or stable pawn id

pawnId.description: Optional stable colonist pawn id from rimworld/list_colonists

drafted.description: True to draft, false to undraft

function.name: game_set_time_speed
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Set RimWorld's current time speed directly; RimBridgeServer enables the boost for speed 4 (Ultrafast) at startup, and this tool can change that state

speed.description: Desired time speed: Paused, Normal, Fast, Superfast, or Ultrafast

ultraSpeedBoost.description: When set, change RimWorld's private TickManager.UltraSpeedBoost flag. RimBridgeServer enables it at startup; l

function.name: game_set_zone_target
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Set or clear the explicit existing-zone target on a zone-add designator

designatorId.description: Stable zone-add designator id returned by rimworld/list_architect_designators

zoneId.description: Zone id from rimworld/list_zones, or omit to clear the explicit zone target

function.name: game_take_screenshot
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Take an in-game screenshot and optionally crop it to a screen target, UI surface, UI element, or scroll-view region

fileName.description: Optional screenshot file name without extension

includeTargets.description: Include current screen target metadata such as windows and context menus

suppressMessage.description: Suppress RimWorld's screenshot-taken message during this automated capture

clipTargetId.description: Optional target id from rimworld/get_screen_targets or rimworld/get_ui_layout to crop around, including window

clipPadding.description: Logical screen-pixel padding to include around the clip target

function.name: look
function.description: [READ-ONLY] Take a screenshot of the game exactly as the stream sees it and SEE it (vision).

function.name: game_state
function.description: [READ-ONLY] One-shot brief: colonists (map, position, job, drafted/downed/mental state), letters, alerts, recent messages, UI window stack.

function.name: pawn_check
function.description: [READ-ONLY-ish: selects the pawn] Select a colonist, open its Needs or Health tab and SEE it so you can find the worst need/injury.

function.name: order_pawn
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Right-click order for one pawn at a cell through the in-game menu (.local/qa/api-prio.py). Omit option to list the menu; option is a label prefix like 'Haul' or 'Prioritize'. queue=true adds after current orders.

function.name: play_slices
function.description: [GAME ACTION] Let the game run N x 10 s at Superfast (1-6) via play.py; it stops on any letter or dialog that needs a decision and prints it.

function.name: run_list
function.description: [MAINTENANCE] Run the maintenance list (.local/qa/run-list.py). Prints OK/FIX lines; the first FIX is your current goal. Note: it changes the selected pawn.

function.name: empire_pass
function.description: [MAINTENANCE] One empire.py pass (stock orders, arms, self-tend, hunt, power and food checks). report_only=true only reports.

function.name: say
function.description: [STREAM] Say a line out loud on stream in Unity's voice (TTS + overlay chat + an auto picture). Clean only: no swearing, no degrading, no emoji, one to three short sentences.

function.name: reply_chat
function.description: [STREAM] Answer a Twitch viewer by name, out loud and in the overlay chat. chat_id is the number given with their message.

function.name: new_colony
function.description: Start a brand-new colony on the company scenario, set up the owner's way (world 30%, 300x300, Spring, pollution 0, factions, mountainous forest tile, the Godsmultiplayer ideoligion, the Preset3 crew, day one). ONLY when the owner orders it. It abandons the current colony.

function.name: plan
function.description: Big planning only (a new base layout, a raid plan, the mountain move, the gate, the space push). Owner: "thinking only for massive plaanning needs and she voice it first and pouses". Say on stream what you are planning, the game is paused, and your NEXT turn thinks deeply. Never for ordinary moves.

function.name: webcam
function.description: [STREAM] Re-render Unity's webcam with a mood and a short clean caption (raids, deaths, wins, chat moments).

function.name: snap
function.description: [STREAM] Post an annotated screenshot of a map rect to the webcam panel with up to 3 circled marks. Moves the camera to the rect.

function.name: read_doc
function.description: [READ-ONLY] Read a repo file for knowledge (docs/, src/, Mod/ ...). Reading only: you can never edit, build or fix code. offset/limit are line numbers.

function.name: ladder
function.description: Read your PLC ladder: the live rung(s) for what is measured right now, every rung that holds, the tag table (constants + live setpoints) and your own marks and rungs. Check it at the start of a turn.

function.name: ladder_set
function.description: Edit your ladder on the fly (open-ended, for the whole empire): op 'mark' (name, value true/false) marks a step done; op 'tag' (name, value) changes a setpoint; op 'add_rung' (rung: {id, priority, when: {measured_key: value}, then: [actions], why}) adds or replaces a rung of your own; op 'remove_rung' (name) removes one of yours. Book rungs from the owner cannot be deleted.

function.name: pawn_priorities
function.description: [GAME ACTION, NO MOUSE] Set ONE pawn's whole work grid in one step, the owner's way: every work type from Firefighter through Cooking = 1, then the levels you give in 'custom' (work name -> 1-4, 0 = off) for the rest. Names: Firefighter Patient Doctor PatientBedRest BasicWorker Warden Handling Cooking Hunting Construction Growing Mining PlantCutting Smithing Tailoring Art Crafting Hauling Cleaning Research. Do one call per pawn.

custom.description: work name -> level 0-4 for types after Cooking

function.name: game_set
function.description: [GAME ACTION, NO MOUSE] Set a field directly through the mod's own automation channel -- works with the window minimised. cmd is one of set_zone_plant (x,z,plant e.g. Plant_Rice), set_zone_sowing (x,z,allow), set_work_priority (pawn,work,level 0-4), set_bed_owner (x,z,owner colonist|prisoner|slave), add_bill (recipe e.g. CookMealSimple, count; x,z optional -- it finds the nearest built table), set_area (pawn,area label or empty). SETUP, one call each, no clicking: explore (every pawn through every door, digs into sealed rooms -- repeat until it says nothing left), rooms (lists explored rooms), stockpile_room (room id, mode food|nofood -- a stockpile filling that room), stockpile_filter (x,z,mode food|nofood|all, priority), beds, shelves, stove, crops (plant), hunt, day_one, assign (the Assign tab: pawn or empty for all, food Fine, medicine Best, hostility Attack). map (optional, e.g. Map_0) picks the map; without it the home map is used. The result comes back from the game: read it.

function.name: twitch_chat
function.description: [STREAM] Type into the REAL Twitch chat (not just out loud). action: say | reply (needs viewer) | title | category. Every line is filtered clean or refused.

function.name: note
function.description: [SCRATCH] Write or append a note in your own scratch folder (the ONLY place you can write).
